narr: Short waves traversed the region during the afternoons at the end of May. This occurred while the area was at peak afternoon heating each day which set the stage for severe thunderstorms to develop.
ev: Flooding was reported in Sulphur and Moss Bluff from heavy rain. The Maple Fork was out of its banks near Coach Williams Drive and a few streets in Moss Bluff were impassable.
The Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office reported street flooding around Fields.
lsr: Water level out of the banks on Coach Williams Road.
Pictures of significant flooding around the Moss Bluff area.
Sheriff Office reports portions of Joe Wingate Rd is beginning to flood.
